d: Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.
r: We're seeking a Customer Care Associate for our Customer Experience team. In this role, you will be crucial in providing answers to customers queries through website and live chat related to Tamara’s services. This role will be based onsite in our Riyadh Office.

Drawing on your proficiency in managing interaction with customers on a daily basis, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer service through accurate information and tailored solutions that address their needs to create unique experiences only Tamara can provide.

With a proven track record of leveraging strong communication skills (written & verbal) to effectively solve customer issues and find solutions quickly, even in a fast-paced environment, and ultimately revolutionize the way millions of users shop, pay, and bank.

You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges.

You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success.
Answer inbound Emails and respond to live chats in an efficient manner.
Identify customer questions, concerns, and overall needs.
Provide accurate answers and solutions to customer queries.
Reviewing customer accounts and transactions while resolving issues.
Understanding and striving to meet support metrics while providing excellent customer service, and follow communication “scripts” when handling different topics.
Reviewing customer accounts and transactions while resolving issues.
Previous customer service experience is a plus.
Fluency in English Language, B2 profile.
Ability to solve problems in a short period of time.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

d: Set along the pristine coastline of Saadiyat Island, Saadiyat Rotana Resort & Villas is a five-star luxury beachfront resort offering 327 rooms and suites, including 13 private beach villas, together with seven distinctive dining venues. The resort features extensive leisure and wellness facilities, including Zen the Spa, a lagoon-style pool, tennis and padel courts, and dedicated family facilities.

We are seeking an experienced, dynamic and commercially minded Director of Human Resources to lead the resort's people agenda and partner closely with the General Manager and leadership team in driving colleague engagement, organizational effectiveness and operational performance.

As Director of Human Resources, you will have overall responsibility for the Human Resources function, ensuring effective people practices, strong colleague engagement and full alignment with Rotana standards and UAE employment requirements.
q: We are looking for an accomplished hospitality HR leader who can combine a strong people focus with the commercial and operational understanding required in a luxury resort environment.
The successful candidate should ideally have
A university degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management or a related discipline.
Strong senior HR leadership experience within the hotel or resort industry, ideally in a luxury or large-scale operation.
Solid knowledge of UAE labour legislation and local HR practices.
Proven experience in manpower planning, recruitment, employee relations, performance management, colleague engagement and talent development.
Strong understanding of hotel operations, payroll and manpower cost management.
Excellent leadership, communication, influencing and relationship-building skills.
A hands-on and visible leadership style with the ability to engage colleagues at all levels.
High levels of integrity, discretion and professional judgment.
Fluency in English; Arabic would be an advantage.

In line with Rotana's HR leadership framework, the successful candidate should demonstrate strong capability in Understanding the Business, Planning for Business, Valuing Diversity, Customer Focus, Influencing Outcomes, Team Building, Leading People, Managing Operations, Adaptability and Drive for Results.
r: Lead the overall HR strategy in line with the resort's business and operational objectives.
Drive manpower planning, recruitment and talent acquisition, ensuring the resort attracts and retains the right talent.
Manage manpower budgets and support effective payroll and workforce cost control.
Champion colleague engagement, welfare, recognition and retention initiatives.
Drive performance management, succession planning and talent development across the resort.
Coach and advise Department Heads on employee relations, performance, disciplinary matters and HR best practices.
Ensure consistent implementation of Rotana HR policies, procedures and corporate standards.
Maintain strong HR governance and compliance with UAE labour legislation.
Oversee colleague welfare and accommodation standards and ensure a positive colleague experience.
Work closely with Learning & Development and operational leaders to strengthen capability and build the internal talent pipeline.
Partner with the General Manager and Executive Committee as a trusted HR advisor, ensuring people decisions support guest experience and overall business performance.

d: The Lead Specialist - Enterprise Sales is accountable for generating sales through maintaining strong relationships with clients and developing new opportunities and partnerships. S/He plans and achieves sales targets, negotiates prices and manages quality and consistency of product and service delivery.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Sales and Marketing or any other related field
At least 5 years of relevant experience,
B2B experience is mandatory, with a strong track record in B2B sales, account management, or business development.
r: Establish and maintain strong business relationships with customers through continuous visits, updates and other initiatives
Study the market for potential clients, approach and build new partnerships leading to sales growth and new opportunities thus increasing profitability
Visit customers to review product/service needs, update orders and follow up on deliverables and other pending issues accordingly
Negotiate and finalize prices and terms of payments with customers within approved brackets and report on action taken and closed deals
Update customers regularly on any product/service changes, new introductions and modifications
Maintain and update customers’ accounts and database on a regular basis
Grant payment facilities and set the credit limit profile for each customer with respect to payments and order history in coordination with the direct manager
Deal with customers’ complaints taking appropriate decisions and report consequent actions to concerned
Conduct regular market visits, prepare a competitors analysis report and build recommendations to increase sales and enhance market positioning
Coordinate with the concerned departments on the introduction of new products/services in the market and stay abreast on modifications and latest changes
Maintain a smooth workflow with other units namely marketing, accounting and supply chain coordinating campaigns, sales metrics and timely deliverables
